changes: Created an adult female with normal human proportions and a light Caucasian skin texture using native MakeHuman macro targets
Used complete native long hair, brown eyes, eyelashes, eyebrows, teeth and tongue
Fitted a plain teal shirt, navy trousers and shoes; masked covered body surfaces and trimmed intersecting sock cuffs
Combined native Meta visemes and ARKit facial targets into seven distinct web morphs on face, eyelids, lashes, teeth and tongue
Baked the fitted human into the motion rig neutral pose, retained skin weights and adapted CC0 body clips
Relaxed the idle stance and fingers; authored pointing IK
Compressed geometry, morphs and animation with meshoptimizer and local embedded colour maps
Set opaque skin, eyes and teeth plus depth-tested hair/lash cutouts to avoid transparent-surface sorting artifacts in the browser
speechTiming: Native browser start and word boundary events with estimated visemes within words; no microphone, remote character service or facial capture.
